info.title: StreamPay API
info.description:
REST API for the StreamPay payment-streaming platform on Stellar.

All error responses use the canonical envelope:
```json
{ "error": { "code": "ERROR_CODE", "message": "Human-readable detail.", "request_id": "req_..." } }
```

v1 stream paths (`/api/streams`) are deprecated and will be removed. Use `/api/v2/streams`.

bearerAuth.description: Obtain a token via POST /api/auth/wallet, then pass it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

rank.description: 1-based position of this leg within the allocation.

stream_id.description: Id of the stream leg written for this recipient; fetch it with GET /api/v2/streams/{id}.

address.description: Stellar ed25519 public key or registered email address, as supplied.

percentage.description: Share of the total, as a fixed 4-decimal string.

amount.description: Amount owed to this leg, as a fixed 7-decimal string. The legs sum exactly to total_amount.

id.description: Identifier of the fan-out itself. It is not a stream; the legs are.

status.description: Every leg is created in `draft`; drive them with the start/pause/stop/settle endpoints.

total_amount.description: Total distributed across all legs, as a fixed 7-decimal string.

allocated_percentage.description: Sum of the allocation, as a fixed 4-decimal string. Always 100.0000 for an accepted request.

settlement.description: Always present; null until a leg settles.

open.description: True when the breaker is tripped and dispatch is halted.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last toggle; null if never toggled.

updatedBy.description: Admin address that last toggled this breaker; null if never toggled.

message.description: Human-readable description safe to display to clients.
message.example: The requested stream does not exist.

get.description: Returns a paginated, cursor-based list of activity events for the authenticated caller. Only events for streams the caller sends or receives, plus the caller's own wallet events, are returned. Events are sorted by (timestamp desc, id desc) for stable ordering. Supports filtering by streamId and event type.

parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque base64-encoded composite cursor (timestamp|id) for cursor-based pagination. Obtained from meta.nextCursor of the previous response.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: Filter events by associated stream identifier. Must match the id charset [A-Za-z0-9._:-]+ and belong to the caller; a non-owned streamId returns 404.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter events by a known type (e.g. stream.created, wallet.connected).

get.description: Returns a one-time challenge the client must sign with their Stellar private key, then submit to `POST /api/auth/wallet`. Challenges are generated with a CSPRNG and have the format `streampay-auth:v1:<nonce>|<origin>|<expires_at>`, where `nonce` is a 43-character base64url value, `origin` is this deployment's origin, and `expires_at` is the ISO-8601 expiry included in the signed message. Responses always have `Cache-Control: no-store` and never answer `304 Not Modified`. The paginated listing mode was removed: `cursor` and `limit` now return `400 UNSUPPORTED_QUERY` because listing outstanding challenges would let unauthenticated callers harvest live challenges for any address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Stellar public key (G…, 56 characters).

400.description: Unsupported query parameters — this endpoint does not list outstanding challenges. `cursor` or `limit` are rejected.

error.message: Query parameters 'cursor' and 'limit' are not supported.

429.description: IP rate limit exceeded for challenge issuance (20 req/min per IP).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

error.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

post.description:
Pauses all active payment streams belonging to the given sender address. Gated by admin auth — only the configured admin address may call this.

Non-active streams (draft, paused, ended) are silently skipped.

**Auth:** Admin wallet address via `Actor-Wallet-Address` header or JWT.

**Idempotency:** Not enforced; repeat calls are safe (already-paused streams are skipped).

senderAddress.description: Stellar wallet address of the sender whose streams should be paused.

get.description:

post.summary: Toggle an indexer or webhook circuit breaker
post.description:
Trips or resets a named subsystem circuit breaker. Gated by admin auth — only the configured admin address may call this.

When `open` is true the named subsystem halts dispatch. For the `webhook` target this means no outbound delivery is attempted and the outbox drain is skipped; pending events are **held, not discarded**, and resume when the breaker is reset. For the `indexer` target the state is surfaced on `GET /api/indexer/status` as `breakerOpen`.

This global operator-controlled breaker is distinct from the automatic per-endpoint failure breaker, which trips itself after repeated delivery failures to a single endpoint and sends that endpoint's deliveries to the DLQ.

**Auth:** Admin wallet address via `Actor-Wallet-Address` header or JWT.

**Idempotency:** Naturally idempotent — setting the same state twice is a no-op beyond the updated timestamp.

open.description: true trips the breaker (halt dispatch); false resets it (resume).
